description: Manage VLANs in Cloud Control network domains.

parameters.name: allow_expand
parameters.description: Permit expansion of the target VLAN’s network if the module parameters specify a larger network than the VLAN currently possesses. If false, the module fails under these conditions. This is intended to prevent accidental expansion of a VLAN’s network (since this operation is not reversible). Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: A description of the VLAN. Default: ""

parameters.name: mcp_password
parameters.description: The password used to authenticate to the CloudControl API. If not specified, falls back to MCP_PASSWORD from environment variable or ~/.dimensiondata. Required if mcp_user is specified.

parameters.name: mcp_user
parameters.description: The username used to authenticate to the CloudControl API. If not specified, falls back to MCP_USER from environment variable or ~/.dimensiondata.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the target VLAN.

parameters.name: network_domain
parameters.description: The ID or name of the target network domain.

parameters.name: private_ipv4_base_address
parameters.description: The base address for the VLAN’s IPv4 network (for example 192.168.1.0). Default: ""

parameters.name: private_ipv4_prefix_size
parameters.description: The size of the IPv4 address space, for example 24. Required, if private_ipv4_base_address is specified. Default: 0

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The target region. Regions are defined in Apache libcloud project [libcloud/common/dimensiondata.py]. They are also listed in https://libcloud.readthedocs.io/en/latest/compute/drivers/dimensiondata.html. Note that the default value na stands for “North America”. The module prepends dd- to the region choice. Default: "na"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The desired state for the target VLAN. readonly ensures that the state is only ever read, not modified (the module fails if the resource does not exist). Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent" "readonly"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: If false, SSL certificates are not validated. This should only be used on private instances of the CloudControl API that use self-signed certificates. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Should we wait for the task to complete before moving onto the next. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: wait_poll_interval
parameters.description: The amount of time (in seconds) to wait between checks for task completion. Only applicable if wait=true. Default: 2

parameters.name: wait_time
parameters.description: The maximum amount of time (in seconds) to wait for the task to complete. Only applicable if wait=true. Default: 600

examples:
- name: Add or update VLAN
  community.general.dimensiondata_vlan:
    region: na
    location: NA5
    network_domain: test_network
    name: my_vlan1
    description: A test VLAN
    private_ipv4_base_address: 192.168.23.0
    private_ipv4_prefix_size: 24
    state: present
    wait: true

- name: Read / get VLAN details
  community.general.dimensiondata_vlan:
    region: na
    location: NA5
    network_domain: test_network
    name: my_vlan1
    state: readonly
    wait: true

- name: Delete a VLAN
  community.general.dimensiondata_vlan:
    region: na
    location: NA5
    network_domain: test_network
    name: my_vlan_1
    state: absent
    wait: true

return_values.name: vlan
return_values.description: Dictionary describing the VLAN. Returned: On success when state=present

return_values.name: description
return_values.description: VLAN description. Returned: success Sample: "My VLAN description"

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: VLAN name. Returned: success Sample: "My VLAN"

return_values.name: private_ipv4_base_address
return_values.description: The base address for the VLAN’s private IPV4 network. Returned: success Sample: "192.168.23.0"

return_values.name: private_ipv4_gateway_address
return_values.description: The gateway address for the VLAN’s private IPV4 network. Returned: success Sample: "192.168.23.1"

return_values.name: private_ipv4_prefix_size
return_values.description: The prefix size for the VLAN’s private IPV4 network. Returned: success Sample: 24

return_values.name: private_ipv6_base_address
return_values.description: The base address for the VLAN’s IPV6 network. Returned: success Sample: "2402:9900:111:1195:0:0:0:0"

return_values.name: private_ipv6_gateway_address
return_values.description: The gateway address for the VLAN’s IPV6 network. Returned: success Sample: "2402:9900:111:1195:0:0:0:1"

return_values.name: private_ipv6_prefix_size
return_values.description: The prefix size for the VLAN’s IPV6 network. Returned: success Sample: 64
